founder.p1: My career began in computer engineering and later expanded into data science, marketing and technology. Working across startups, AI companies and growth teams taught me that most businesses don't have a design problem, they have a clarity problem.

studio.p1: The most important part of a brand is the part no one sees first — the thinking beneath it. Before a business can be expressed, it has to be understood. So we start at the core: what a business is, what it believes, and why it matters. Everything visible grows from there.
studio.p2: Businesses of real quality are rarely broken — they're scattered, their best work spread across parts that were never designed to work together. We don't decorate; we clarify. Strategy, identity, words, websites and technology are built as one coherent system, in one room, rather than handed between departments.
studio.p3: The result isn't a new look. It's a brand that finally matches the business behind it — built to last, not to trend. A single, considered world across every touchpoint.
studio.p4: noova works between London and Tirana — two cities, one level of care. Wherever a project begins, it's held to the same rigour and the same restraint.
